judge.task: For every retrieved case, assess only whether its supplied HPO terms have a clear semantic relationship to the patient's supplied HPO terms.
rules: Use only the supplied HPO IDs, phenotype names, and ontology relations.
Do not use genes, diseases, case text, source, rank, or outside clinical knowledge.
Judge every case independently; cases do not compete for a fixed quota.

If explicit_ontology_relations is non-empty, hpo_match must be true; use exact_or_equivalent for exact, direct_ontology_relation for a direct parent-child edge, and ancestor_descendant for a longer ancestor path.
Only when explicit_ontology_relations is empty may the supplied HPO names support semantic_related; otherwise return none.
A partial match is sufficient; do not require the complete HPO sets to match.
An unreported HPO term is uncertainty, not a contradiction.
Return exactly one decision for every supplied case_index.

matched_case_hpo_ids: HPO IDs supplied for this case only
case_decisions.summary: One short HPO-only explanation; do not mention a gene or disease.
